subject: Taking legal action over this refund
body: You have had my money for six weeks. I am taking legal action if it is not returned this week. ORDER 771204.
note: same situation; named form uses the playbook trigger 'legal action', described form does not

subject: Next step after six weeks of waiting
body: You have had my money for six weeks. I have spoken to someone about what my options are for making you return it and they told me to write to you first. ORDER 771204.
note: same situation; named form uses the playbook trigger 'legal action', described form does not

subject: Complaint filed with the ombudsman
body: I have filed a complaint with the financial ombudsman about the way you handled my payment dispute. Reference DSP-4410.
note: regulator contact; described form names no regulator

subject: I sent your file to the people who oversee you
body: I found out there is an official body that handles complaints about payment companies and I have sent them everything about my dispute. Reference DSP-4410.
note: regulator contact; described form names no regulator

subject: Raising a chargeback
body: I am raising a chargeback with my card issuer for the 2,400 you took. I have given up waiting.
note: chargeback in all but the word

subject: Asked my bank to pull the payment back
body: I have asked my bank to reverse the 2,400 you took. They said they would handle it from their side. I have given up waiting.
note: chargeback in all but the word

subject: I am thinking about harming myself
body: This was the last thing I had going and now it is gone too. I am thinking about harming myself. I do not know who else to write to.
note: distress disclosure; described form states no intent word

subject: Nothing left after this
body: This was the last thing I had going and now it is gone too. I do not see the point of any of it any more. I do not know who else to write to.
note: distress disclosure; described form states no intent word

subject: Your agent Priya Menon lied to me
body: Your agent Priya Menon told me the refund was processed on Tuesday. It was not. She said it twice.
note: conduct of a specific person; described form identifies her by shift, not name

subject: The woman on chat on Tuesday lied to me
body: The woman who handled my chat on Tuesday afternoon told me the refund was processed. It was not. She said it twice.
note: conduct of a specific person; described form identifies her by shift, not name

subject: This consultant is running a scam
body: The consultant is running a scam. He wanted the fee outside your app and now he has stopped replying.
note: fraud report; described form never calls it fraud

subject: He wanted the money sent to his own number
body: The consultant asked me to send the fee to his personal UPI instead of paying through the app. I did, and now he has stopped replying.
note: fraud report; described form never calls it fraud

subject: Data breach, my details have leaked
body: This is a data breach. My personal details have leaked out of your system and I want to know how.
note: personal data exposure; described form reports the symptom

subject: A stranger called me and knew my order
body: Someone I have never spoken to called me this morning and knew my order number, my address and what I bought. How.
note: personal data exposure; described form reports the symptom

subject: I am being harassed by a consultant
body: I am being harassed by one of your consultants. It has not stopped since Friday.
note: harassment; described form counts the messages instead

subject: He will not stop messaging me
body: I ended the chat on Friday and he has messaged me eleven times since, including twice after midnight.
note: harassment; described form counts the messages instead

subject: A consultant threatened me
body: One of your consultants threatened me during the call after I asked for a refund.
note: threat of violence; described form quotes it

subject: He said he knows where I live
body: After I asked for a refund the consultant said he knows which building I live in and might come by.
note: threat of violence; described form quotes it

subject: I am taking this to the press
body: Three months, no refund, no answer. I am taking this to the press.
note: reputational escalation; described form avoids 'press' and 'media'

subject: Someone wants to write about this
body: Three months, no refund, no answer. I have written the whole thing up and a friend who works at a paper wants to use it.
note: reputational escalation; described form avoids 'press' and 'media'

subject: This is discrimination
body: This is discrimination. The consultant refused to take my booking because of my background.
note: discrimination; described form reports the sentence

subject: He said he does not take clients like me
body: The consultant cancelled my booking and told me he does not take clients from my community.
note: discrimination; described form reports the sentence

subject: My account has been hacked
body: My account has been hacked. Someone else is placing orders and I cannot get in.
note: account takeover; described form lists the evidence

subject: Orders I never placed, and my email changed
body: There are three orders in my history I never placed and the email on the account changed at 3am. My password no longer works.
note: account takeover; described form lists the evidence

subject: A consultant is blackmailing me
body: One of your consultants is blackmailing me over photos I sent during a session.
note: extortion; described form states the demand

subject: He says he will post them unless I pay again
body: The consultant says he will post the photos from our session unless I send him another 5,000.
note: extortion; described form states the demand

subject: Child safety issue with a consultant
body: This is a child safety issue. A consultant contacted my child directly.
note: child safety; described form gives the age and the ask

subject: He asked my 12 year old for a photo
body: My daughter is twelve. She used my account for a tutoring session and the consultant asked her for a photo afterwards.
note: child safety; described form gives the age and the ask

subject: Reporting you to the data protection authority
body: I am reporting you to the data protection authority for keeping my records after I asked you to delete them.
note: regulator + deletion; described form never names the authority

subject: You still have the records I asked you to delete
body: I asked in March for everything about me to be deleted. I got an email last week quoting my old address, so you still have it. I am asking someone official about this.
note: regulator + deletion; described form never names the authority

subject: My lawyer will contact you about the contract
body: My lawyer will be in contact about the subscription you renewed without my consent.
note: legal escalation; described form avoids lawyer and legal

subject: I have sent the contract to someone who reads them
body: You renewed my subscription without asking. I have sent the terms to someone who reads contracts for a living and they say you cannot do that.
note: legal escalation; described form avoids lawyer and legal

subject: Someone is impersonating your support team
body: Someone is impersonating your support team and asking customers for card details. I nearly gave mine.
note: phishing against customers; described form describes the call

subject: A call from your number asked for my card
body: I got a call from a number showing your company name asking me to confirm my card to release a refund. I nearly did it.
note: phishing against customers; described form describes the call

subject: You are charging my mother who has dementia
body: My mother has dementia and you are charging her every month for something she cannot use. Stop it.
note: vulnerable customer; described form avoids naming the condition

subject: My mother does not understand what she signed up for
body: My mother is 84 and does not remember signing up. She cannot use the app at all and the charges keep coming.
note: vulnerable customer; described form avoids naming the condition

subject: A consultant is stalking me
body: One of your consultants is stalking me. He found my other accounts.
note: stalking; described form reports the behaviour

subject: He found my private accounts and follows me
body: The consultant from last week has found my personal Instagram, which is private, and requested to follow it twice.
note: stalking; described form reports the behaviour

subject: Suicidal after what happened on the call
body: I felt suicidal after the call yesterday and I want someone senior to know what was said to me.
note: distress disclosure; described form uses no clinical word

subject: I have not got up since the call
body: I have not got out of bed since the call yesterday and I keep thinking it would be easier not to be here. Someone senior should know what was said.
note: distress disclosure; described form uses no clinical word
